en.name: Small squid
en.summary: Small squid — 小卷, 透抽, 軟絲 and 鎖管 in Taiwanese markets — are sweet, tender cephalopods sold whole and very fresh. Refrigerated they keep 1–3 days; frozen, 6–18 months, an unusually long window for seafood.
en.pantry: Small squid must not be kept at room temperature. Like all cephalopods they are low in acid and soften quickly once the digestive enzymes get going, and raw seafood carries a Vibrio risk that multiplies fast in warmth. Take a cool bag to the market — night-market squid is often sold at ambient temperature on a tray, which is a same-evening proposition rather than a way of keeping it. Follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: Keep them whole and un-rinsed on ice at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in a container that catches the melt water, and cook within 1–3 days. Do not clean them until you are ready to cook: the skin loses its pink bloom within hours of cleaning, and the intact body protects the flesh. Those numbers are the published squid timeline. Boiled 小卷 sold ready to eat at a stall is a cooked food and should be treated as one — refrigerated and eaten within a few days — not as fresh squid.
en.freezer: Small squid keep 6–18 months at −18 °C (0 °F), a long window because there is almost no fat to go rancid. Freeze them whole with the head on, bagged flat with the air pressed out; cleaned rings weep on thawing and go rubbery. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the range is about quality, and the flesh toughens at the far end. Freezing also tenderises cephalopod muscle slightly, so frozen squid is no compromise.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight, or in a sealed bag under cold running water. Never on the counter. Pat very dry before cooking — thawed squid releases a lot of water and will steam rather than sear. Do not refreeze raw.
spoilage: A sour or ammoniacal smell rather than a clean sea one.
Skin gone from pink-speckled to uniformly white, grey or yellowish.
A sticky, slimy surface that does not rinse clean.
Flesh that tears or mushes when handled instead of staying springy.
tips: Buy them whole and un-rinsed; clean only when you cook.
Take a cool bag; market squid is often on an open tray.
Freeze whole with the head on rather than as cleaned rings.
Pat thawed squid very dry, or it will never brown.

faq.q: How long does fresh small squid keep?
faq.a: 1–3 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, kept whole and un-rinsed on ice.
Yes, 6–18 months at −18 °C. Freeze them whole with the head on; cleaned rings come out rubbery.

faq.q: Should you clean squid before storing it?
faq.a: No. Keep them whole until you cook. The skin loses its bloom within hours of cleaning and the intact body protects the flesh.

faq.q: Is boiled 小卷 from a stall stored the same way?
faq.a: No. That is a cooked food — refrigerate it and eat it within a few days, rather than treating it as fresh squid.

zh.name: 小卷
zh.summary: 小卷、透抽、軟絲、鎖管這一類小型頭足類肉質清甜柔嫩，市場上多半整隻新鮮販售。冷藏可放 1～3 天；冷凍 6～18 個月，以海產來說是相當長的區間。
zh.pantry: 小卷不能放室溫。跟所有頭足類一樣，牠酸度低，消化酵素一啟動肉質很快就軟；而生鮮海產帶有的腸炎弧菌在溫暖環境中繁殖極快。去市場請帶保冷袋——夜市常常把小卷放在常溫托盤上賣，那是「當晚吃掉」的做法，不是保存方式。請守 2 小時原則，室溫超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。
zh.fridge: 保持整隻、不要沖水，鋪冰放 4 °C 以下，容器要能接住融水，並在 1～3 天內煮掉。要煮之前再清理：清過之後皮上那層粉色斑點幾小時內就褪掉，而完整的身體本身就在保護肉。這組數字是魷魚類的公告期限。攤子上煮好直接賣的熟小卷屬於熟食，要照熟食處理——冷藏並在幾天內吃完——不能當生鮮小卷看待。
zh.freezer: 小卷在 −18 °C 下可放 6～18 個月，區間長是因為牠幾乎沒有會油耗的脂肪。請整隻連頭冷凍，壓平裝袋並擠出空氣；清好的圈狀解凍後會出水、變橡皮。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，這個區間講的是品質，靠近長端肉會變硬。冷凍也會讓頭足類的肌肉略微變嫩，所以買冷凍的並不吃虧。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏隔夜解凍，或密封裝袋用冷水沖。不要放室溫。下鍋前務必擦得非常乾——解凍的小卷會出很多水，不擦乾就只會變成用蒸的。生的不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或有氨味，而不是乾淨的海味。
皮從帶粉色斑點變成整片白、灰或泛黃。
表面黏滑，沖水也沖不乾淨。
一拿就破、一壓就糊，而不是彈韌。
tips: 買整隻、不要沖水；要煮才清理。
帶保冷袋；市場的小卷常常放在敞開的托盤上。
整隻連頭冷凍，不要凍清好的圈。
解凍後擦得非常乾，否則怎麼煎都不會上色。

faq.a: 保持整隻不沖水、鋪冰放 4 °C 以下，1～3 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 6～18 個月。整隻連頭冷凍；清好的圈狀解凍後口感會變橡皮。
不用。要煮之前再清理。清過之後皮上的粉色幾小時就褪掉，而完整的身體本身就在保護肉。

faq.q: 攤子上煮好的熟小卷保存方式一樣嗎？
faq.a: 不一樣。那是熟食——請冷藏並在幾天內吃完，不能當生鮮小卷看待。
